answer: Require a 300-unit escrowed bond and a twenty-epoch probation per identity. Each epoch the agent finishes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers whose recent counterparties never overlap; recycled proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for seven epochs. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil ring thus locks 300 units per alias and replays twenty rounds, while an echo of identical traces exposes it, gale-driven task rotation scatters effort, and prism-sealed receipts prove each review.
